{{Quote|I held a single-entrance fortress similar to this on Amador. Enemy bodies were stacked twenty-high around the outside when that battle was over.|Fideltin Rusk|<ref name="Ambient" />}}
Sometime between [[3667 BBY|3667]] and [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Fideltin Rusk]] fought in a '''battle''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Amador]]. During the fighting, the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] defended the single entrance of a [[Amador fortress|fortress]] by himself, and by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the Republic emerged victorious, Rusk had [[Death/Legends|killed]] enough [[Imperial soldier]]s to stack their bodies in a wall twenty corpses high. When Rusk visited the [[Shrine of Healing]] on the planet [[Voss]] well over a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] later, he was reminded of the fortress and the fighting on Amador.<ref name="Ambient" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle on Amador is mentioned only once in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in the ambient conversation that is triggered when the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] companion character Fideltin Rusk is near the Shrine of Healing.<ref name="Ambient" />
